front.name: Medic
front.text: Thrice Per Round: Choose {1} Mercenary you control within {1} lane. They gain {+1} {armor} for this turn. This cannot stack.

front.name: Tiptoe
front.text: Start of Each Phase: {Exhaust} {1} {wall}. When an opposing Mercenary {rotates} or {pushes} to become adjacent to those {walls}, they must {ready} it and then pay {2} {ticks} or damage their {armor} {1} for each of them {readied}. (This persists if this Merc dies.)

front.name: Thermal
front.text: Start of Each Phase: {Exhaust} {1} {wall}. When an opposing Mercenary {rotates} or {pushes} to become adjacent to those {walls}, they must {ready} it and then pay {2} {ticks} or damage their {armor} {1} for each of them {readied}. (This persists if this Merc dies.)

front.name: Smog
front.text: On {Exhaust}: You may play {1} {Gas Canister Token} to the firefight chain.

front.name: Barricade
front.text: Once Per Round: Create {1} additional {reinforced wall} in this Merc's lane. (Even if there is not an empty {wall} slot.)

front.name: Cryo
front.text: Firefight: You may {exhaust} this card to choose {1} {non-Merc} card in this card's lane. If it is in the Combat Zone, its {tick} cost gains {+2}.

front.name: Ghost
front.text: On Attack: {Disable} an opposing {electronics} effect targeting this Merc within the chain. If you did, you may activate {flanker} again, gain {+2} {firepower} for this turn, or both.

front.name: Packhound + Brutus
front.text: This Game: {Hound} {assets} you play that survive the Combat Zone enter the playing field.

front.name: Knight
front.text: Start of Action Phase: Mercs you control in this lane gain {+1} {armor}. (To a max of {3}.)

front.name: Null
front.text: While Ready: Opposing {electronics} in this Merc's lane lose all ability text.

front.name: Patches
front.text: Twice Per Round: Choose your lane or an adjacent lane. Then choose {1}: (1) If there is a {soft wall} there, replace it with a {reinforced wall} or (2) if there is a {wall} missing in that lane, place a {soft wall} there.

front.name: Tinker
front.text: Firefight: Choose {1} {asset} from your {Casualty Pile}. Swap the chosen {asset} with an {asset} from your hand. You may then play that {asset} to the Combat Zone at this card's slot.

front.name: Enforcer
front.text: Firefight: Destroy {1} {soft wall} in this Merc's lane. Then you may close the Combat Zone stack. (Resolve the Combat Zone and end the turn.)

front.name: Shrapnel
front.text: Twice Per Round: Choose {1} {reinforced wall} in this Merc's lane. At the start of your next turn, destroy that {reinforced wall} and {1} additional {wall} adjacent to it.

front.name: Termite
front.text: On Attack: You may destroy {1} {soft wall} in your lane or an adjacent lane.

front.name: Torch
front.text: Your Turn: Choose {1} {wall} in this Merc's lane. {Exhaust} that wall and then choose {1}: (1) Destroy that {wall} or (2) for the rest of the round, your Merc's firefights in that wall's lane may deal {headshots}.

front.name: Collector
front.text: Twice Per Round: Destroy {1} {drone} you control to mark {1} opposing Merc. This Merc gains {+4} {firepower} when attacking that Merc in firefights. Only {1} of these marks may exist at a time.

front.name: Pointman
front.text: This Merc may {push} lanes that have at least {1} destroyed or {exhausted} {wall}. On Push: Deal {1} damage to an opposing Merc if it is the only opposing Merc in that lane.

front.name: Thumper
front.text: On Attack: Choose {1}: (1) Destroy {1} {bulletproof} card, (2) remove {protector} from a card in the target's lane, or (3) if this attack would not kill the target, perform a {push} or {rotate} action.

front.name: Tremor
front.text: Once Per Round: Until the end of this turn, opposing cards that {push} or {rotate} are treated as having {-1} {armor} for this turn's firefights. (To a minimum of {1} {armor}.)

front.name: Aegis
front.text: This Merc's {protector} effect applies to all current and future opposing damage for this turn. On {Exhaust}: Until thte end of this turn, this Merc's {firepower} becomes {0} and it gains {bulletproof}.

front.name: Mule
front.text: Start of the Action Phase: Choose {1} {attacker asset} and add it to your hand.

front.name: Spectra
front.text: Twice Per Round: Reveal {3} cards from your opponent's hand. Then you may pay {2} {ticks} to {disable} {1} card from their hand.

front.name: Surge
front.text: Twice Per Round: your opponent must select {3} {electronics} they control between this Mercenary's lane and their hand. Those {electronics} lose all ability text until the end of your next turn.

front.name: Barbed Wire
front.text: Firefight: Opposing {push} actions in this lane cost {2x} their {ticks} to perform.}

front.name: Bulletproof Camera
front.text: Firefight: Reveal {3} cards from your opponent's hand. Then {disable} {2} cards from their hand.

front.name: Guard Hound
front.text: Firefight: (Man's best friend proves their worth in teeth and blood.)

front.name: Impact Grenade
front.text: Firefight: Choose {1} {soft wall} in your Merc's lane or an adjacent lane to them. Desttroy that {soft wall}. Then, choose {1}: (1) {push} {1} Merc in that wall's lane or (2) {exhaust} {1} Merc in that wall's lane to add them as an attacker to any chain slot in the Combat Zone.

front.name: Portable Shield
front.text: Firefight: Place this card into your Merc's lane if it is not destroyed in the {firefight}.

front.name: Shrappak
front.text: This card may only be played as a reactiton in the Combat Zone. Firefight: Choose {1}: (1) Deal {2} damage to a card in this lane or destroy {1} {asset}.

front.name: Sidearm
front.text: On Play: Choose {1} opposing card in the Combat Zone. This card attacks that card.

front.name: 3S Stim Kit
front.text: Firefight: Choose this card's {speed} or {armor}. This card and all its replicates you control lose the chosen stat for the rest of the round to give a mercenary you control that additional stat until the end of this turn.

front.name: Attack Hound
front.text: On Play: Choose {1}: (1) Reveal your opponent's hand or (2) deal {1} damage to {1} card in this lane.

front.name: Breaching Charge
front.text: Firefight: Choose {1} {wall} in a Mercenary's lane you control. Destroy that {wall}.

front.name: Flashbang
front.text: Firefight: Choose {1} opposing Mercenary in this card's lane. They gain {-1} {armor} and {speed} for this turn and do not deal damage this turn.

front.name: Frag Grenade
front.text: Firefight: Choose {1} card in your lane or an adjacent lane. Deal {1} damage to that card. If it was a {soft wall}, {exhaust} it to allow {headshots} in that lane.

front.name: Rapid Reload Mags
front.text: Firefight: Choose {1} Mercenary you control in the Combat Zone. They attack another card in the Combat Zone (paying the tick cost still).

front.name: Smoke Grenade
front.text: Firefight: Choose your Merc's lane or an adjacent lane to them. Until your next turn, opposing Mercs may not start or join firefights in the chosen lane if they are not in that lane. Then, you may {rotate} or {push}.

front.name: Operation Falling Bird
front.text: This Game: If there is {15} or fewer {ticks} at the start of the turn, destroy {1} random {wall}. When The Bomb Is Planted: Flip this card.

front.name: Operation Heavy Swells
front.text: Start of Each Turn: Randomly shift all {walls} to the left or right {1} lane (wrapping to the opposite side if needed). {Reinforced walls} shifted this way deal {1} damage to a random card in its new lane. When The Bomb Is Planted: Flip this card.

front.name: Operation Iron Bayou
front.text: Start of Each Phase: Reduce the shared {ticks} pool by {4}. When The Bomb Is Planted: Flip this card.

front.name: Operation Paper Tower
front.text: This Game: Firefights in lanes with {soft walls} may deal {headshots}. When The Bomb Is Planted: Flip this card.

front.name: Operation Velvet Tomb
front.text: This Game: All cards gain {+1} {firepower}. When The Bomb Is Planted: Flip this card.

front.name: Soft Wall
front.text: {Headshots} cannot occur in this lane while a wall exists there. This card also must be destroyed by {explosives}.

front.name: Reinforced Wall
front.text: {Headshots} cannot occur in this lane while a wall exists there. This card also must be destroyed by {explosives}.

front.name: Default Camera
front.text: Your Turn: Reveal {1} card from your opponent's hand. Then {disable} a card from their hand. (Temporarily remove that card from the game. At the begginning of their next turn, return all {disabled} cards they control back to their hand.)

front.name: Default Drone
front.text: Your Turn: Reveal {1} card from your opponent's hand. Then {disable} a card from their hand. (Temporarily remove that card from the game. At the begginning of their next turn, return all {disabled} cards they control back to their hand.)

front.name: Defuse Card
front.text: {Real} or {Fake}

front.name: Brutus
front.text: This Game: When this card {rotates}, it may {rotate} up to {2} lanes. While this card is in a lane with an opposing {flanker}, they cannot move.

front.name: Gas Canister
front.text: On Play: {Non-Smog} Mercs in this card's lane that perform actions after this card in the chain must be damaged {1} {armor} as an additional cost.
